ambiguities.source_text: Total `avg_tenure_months`: mean `tenure_months` across all transfer events (all flagged records), rounded to two decimals.
ambiguities.intent: Total mean tenure is calculated across transfer records, not as an unweighted average of DC means.

ambiguities.source_text: Total `ee_count`: distinct `employee_id` across the entire dataset (all DCs and all months).
